dialogue.content: こんばんわ　SNS相談員です
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm an SNS counselor.

dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談者です
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm here for counseling.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Thank you for reaching out.

dialogue.content: どうぞよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談ですか？お名前をお伺いしてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today? May I ask your name?

dialogue.content: あまなつです学校に行く意味がわかりません
dialogue.English: I'm Amanatsu. I don't see the point of going to school.

dialogue.content: あまなつさんですね　ありがとうございます学校に行く意味がわからないのですね
dialogue.English: Amanatsu, right? Thank you. So, you're feeling like there's no point in going to school.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いつ頃からそのように感じてるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How long have you been feeling this way?

dialogue.content: 高校1年の3学期くらいからです
dialogue.English: Since around the third term of my first year of high school.

dialogue.content: はい、今は何年生でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. And what year are you in now?

dialogue.content: ２年です
dialogue.English: I'm a second-year.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね　もう半年くらい　学校に行く意味を考えているのですね
dialogue.English: I see—so you've been questioning the point of going to school for about half a year.

dialogue.content: 行きたくなくて、お腹が痛くなることが多いです
dialogue.English: I often get stomachaches because I don't want to go.

dialogue.content: 何か学校に行くことに疑問がでてきたのは何かきっかけがあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Was there any particular trigger that made you start questioning the point of going to school?

dialogue.content: ごめんなさい　被りましたね
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, our messages overlapped.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です
dialogue.English: It's okay.

dialogue.content: お腹がいたくなったりするのですねそれは辛いですね
dialogue.English: So you've been getting stomachaches. That must be tough.

dialogue.content: 授業もつまらないし、先生もどうでもいいことでいちいちうるさいです
dialogue.English: The classes are boring, and the teachers are always nagging about trivial things.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね　それは意味も考えてしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I can see that. That would certainly make you question the point of it all.

dialogue.content: 教科書読んでるだけで、先生もやる気ない
dialogue.English: They just read from the textbook; the teachers have no motivation either.

dialogue.content: 例えば先生はどのようなことでうるさく言われるのですか？
dialogue.English: For example, what kind of things do the teachers nag you about?

dialogue.content: 髪の毛ちょっと明るかったり、遅刻して行った時とか
dialogue.English: Like if my hair is a little too light, or when I'm late.

dialogue.content: そんな先生もいますよね　ただ一人で進めていく感じ校則も結構厳しい学校だったのですね
dialogue.English: Yes, some teachers are like that. It sounds like they just do things their own way. So, the school rules are quite strict, then?

dialogue.content: 男子と女子で態度の変わる先生もうざいです
dialogue.English: It's also annoying how some teachers treat boys and girls differently.

dialogue.content: 男女の差別もあるんですね　最悪ですねちなみに　あまなつさんは　どちらか聞いてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: There's gender discrimination too? That's awful. By the way, may I ask if you're male or female, Amanatsu?

dialogue.content: 髪の毛の色も 3年には何も言いません
dialogue.English: They don't say anything to the third-years about their hair color either.

dialogue.content: 女子です
dialogue.English: I'm female.

dialogue.content: え？３年生にはうるさく言わないのですか？それはどうしてですか？
dialogue.English: What? They don't nag the third-years? Why is that?

dialogue.content: わかりません
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: そんな学校の先生方の方針には嫌気がさしてきているのですね
dialogue.English: So you're getting fed up with the way the teachers at your school do things.

dialogue.content: 担任の先生が体育会のノリで、誰かのミスを連帯責任だとか言ってネチネチ説教するのとか、いやです
dialogue.English: My homeroom teacher has this jock-like attitude, and I hate it when they lecture us naggingly about collective responsibility for someone else's mistake.

dialogue.content: それなのに、イベント時には伝説を作ろう！とか言って熱いこと言って泣いたりするの、やめてほしいです
dialogue.English: And then during school events, they get all emotional and cry, saying passionate things like, 'Let's make a legend!' I wish they'd stop.

dialogue.content: うわ　体育会のノリで　そんなことしてくるの？　熱血ぶって泣いたりしてくるんですか？　それはちょっと引いてしまいますね
dialogue.English: Wow, with that jock-like attitude, they do that? They act all passionate and even cry? That's a bit of a turn-off.

dialogue.content: はい 引きます
dialogue.English: Yes, it's very off-putting.

dialogue.content: その感じはすごく理解できます
dialogue.English: I can totally understand that feeling.

dialogue.content: 年をとりたくないって思います
dialogue.English: It makes me not want to grow up.

dialogue.content: その先生は何歳くらいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: About how old is that teacher?

dialogue.content: ごめんなさい　ちょっと世代がきになってしまいました
dialogue.English: Sorry—I just got curious about their generation.

dialogue.content: 担任は40くらいだと思います
dialogue.English: I think my homeroom teacher is around 40.

dialogue.content: そうですか...受けると思ってしているのでしょうね
dialogue.English: I see... They probably think it's well-received.

dialogue.content: それでお話は変わりますが
dialogue.English: On a different note...

dialogue.content: はい。たぶん。全然受けてないことに気付いてないのが、終わってるなと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, probably. The fact that they don't realize it's not well-received at all is just pathetic.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あまなつさんは　学校に行きたくないと思われるのは先生や校則が厳しいから学校にいく意味がわからなくなってきているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Amanatsu, do you feel like you don't want to go to school because the teachers and strict school rules are making you question the point of it?

dialogue.content: 授業もつまらないし、先生もつまらない
dialogue.English: The classes are boring, and the teachers are boring too.

dialogue.content: はい　内容を聞いて納得しましたその他に　お友だちとか　クラブ活動とかには興味がないですか？
dialogue.English: I see, that makes sense. Besides that, are you not interested in things like your friends or club activities?

dialogue.content: 何か他にやりたいこととかあったりしますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else you'd like to do?

dialogue.content: 仲のいい友達はいますクラスでは一軍のグループにいるので、それなりに楽しいですクラブは入ってないです
dialogue.English: I have close friends. I'm in the 'top-tier' group in my class, so it's fun in its own way. I'm not in any clubs.

dialogue.content: 一軍のグループ　なんかかっこいいですね
dialogue.English: The top-tier group... that sounds cool.

dialogue.content: やりたいことは特にないです しいて言えば 寝ていたいです
dialogue.English: I don't have anything I particularly want to do. If I had to say, I'd rather be sleeping.

dialogue.content: どのグループに所属するかは大きな問題です
dialogue.English: Which group you belong to is a big deal.

dialogue.content: グループで分けられているんですねそれが大きな問題に？もう少し詳しく聞いていいですか？
dialogue.English: So, people are divided into groups. How is that a big deal? Could you tell me a bit more?

dialogue.content: 一軍は陽キャで学外に友達が多いとか、インスタのフォロワーが多いとかおしゃれとか、いろんな条件です周りから認められないと入れないです
dialogue.English: The top-tier group is for the popular kids—the ones who have lots of friends outside of school, lots of Instagram followers, are fashionable... there are various conditions. You can't get in unless you're accepted by the others.

dialogue.content: 3軍とかは陰キャで 存在感ないです
dialogue.English: The third-tier group is for the unpopular kids who don't have much of a presence.

dialogue.content: すごいですね　そんなに条件があって　認められるとかで選別されるんですか？それは大変ですね
dialogue.English: Wow, that's intense. So you're sorted based on whether you're accepted? That sounds tough.

dialogue.content: それを選別する人はどんな方なのですか？
dialogue.English: Who are the ones doing the sorting?

dialogue.content: なんとなく目立ってたりSNSで有名だったりする子がいて そこに認められたり 友達の友達だったりで繋がります
dialogue.English: There are kids who just stand out or are famous on social media, and you get connected by being accepted by them or by being a friend of a friend.

dialogue.content: 暗黙の了解ですね
dialogue.English: It's an unspoken rule.

dialogue.content: 入学時が重要です
dialogue.English: The beginning of the school year is crucial.

dialogue.content: 最初が肝心
dialogue.English: The beginning is crucial.

dialogue.content: なんとかグループに入れたから 後はそれをキープするって感じです
dialogue.English: I managed to get into the group, so now it's just about maintaining my place.

dialogue.content: いろいろ気を使ってますが、今の時代はそれが普通です
dialogue.English: I have to be careful about a lot of things, but that's normal these days.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね　目立つ子がいてこの子に認められるかで決まってしまうのですね友達関係も重要になってくるということですね入学してからずーと　キープしなくてはいけないということですね
dialogue.English: I see. So there are standout kids, and everything is decided by whether they accept you. Friendships are very important, then. And you have to maintain that status ever since you started school.

dialogue.content: なので友達関係は問題ないですね
dialogue.English: So, I don't have any problems with my friends.

dialogue.content: まあ なんとか大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yeah, I'm managing okay.

dialogue.content: ここらで少し要約をさせていただいてもいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be okay if I summarized things a bit here?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あまなつさんは　今学校にいく意味がわからなくなっている高校２年生の女子ですねときどきお腹が痛くなるほど悩んでらっしゃる
dialogue.English: Okay, so Amanatsu, you're a female second-year high school student who is questioning the point of going to school. You're worried to the point where you sometimes get stomachaches.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 授業も面白くないし、先生も厳しくねちねち言ってきたり　時には熱血の先生ぶって涙して　引いてきている
dialogue.English: The classes aren't interesting, the teachers are strict and nag you, and sometimes they act all passionate and cry, which you find off-putting.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 変な先生ばっかりです
dialogue.English: It's just a bunch of weird teachers.

dialogue.content: そうですか　笑
dialogue.English: I see. (laughs)

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 友人はたくさんいて楽しいグループには所属している一軍という　陽キャラのメンバーでおしゃれな　目立つ子たちのグループで
dialogue.English: You have a lot of friends and belong to a fun group, the 'top-tier' one, which is made up of popular, fashionable, and standout kids.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 入学当時からそのグループに入れるのは　暗黙の了解で認められた人しか入れない　特別なグループということですね
dialogue.English: And getting into that group since the start of school is a special thing, where only those who are accepted by an unspoken rule can join.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: だけども　学校に行くよりかは寝ている方がましだと思ってきているのですね
dialogue.English: But even so, you've come to feel that sleeping is better than going to school.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How does that sound?

dialogue.content: 寝ている方がましというより、寝ている時が一番幸せです できればずっと寝ていたいです
dialogue.English: It's less that sleeping is better, and more that I'm happiest when I'm sleeping. I wish I could just sleep forever.

dialogue.content: そうですか　失礼しました寝ているときが一番幸せなんですねずーっとと言われるのは　どんな思いがあってのことですか？
dialogue.English: I see. My apologies. So you're happiest when you're sleeping. When you say you wish you could sleep forever, what feelings are behind that?

dialogue.content: 布団は気持ちいいし、何も考えずに入れるし
dialogue.English: My bed is comfortable, and I can be there without thinking about anything.

dialogue.content: いられるし
dialogue.English: ...and I can just be there.

dialogue.content: ふかふかで気持ちいいですよね夢をみて眠るのは幸せですね
dialogue.English: A soft, fluffy bed feels great, doesn't it? It's blissful to sleep and have dreams.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: 目が覚めたら　まず最初にどんな事を考えてしまいますか？
dialogue.English: When you wake up, what's the very first thing you think about?

dialogue.content: あー 今日も1日が始まってしまうな
dialogue.English: "Ah, another day is starting again."

dialogue.content: そうですよね　毎日の始まりですよね一番何がきがかりですか？
dialogue.English: Right, the start of another day. What's your biggest concern?

dialogue.content: 本当は行きたくないけど、高校は出席日数足りないと留年するから。高校中退の勇気はない
dialogue.English: I really don't want to go, but if I don't have enough attendance days in high school, I'll have to repeat the year. I don't have the courage to drop out.

dialogue.content: 高校は卒業したいですよね
dialogue.English: You do want to graduate from high school, right?

dialogue.content: さすがにまずいかなと思う
dialogue.English: I think it would be pretty bad if I didn't.

dialogue.content: 進学は考えていないのですか？
dialogue.English: Are you not considering further education?

dialogue.content: 大学か専門学校 どこでもいけるところでいいって感じ働くのはまだちょっといいかな
dialogue.English: A university or vocational school, whichever one I can get into is fine. I'm not really ready to work yet.

dialogue.content: 親は大学進学するもんだと思ってる
dialogue.English: My parents assume I'll go to university.

dialogue.content: ちゃんと進路も考えてこられてるのですねもう少しですよね
dialogue.English: It sounds like you have thought properly about your future path. It's just a little longer, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 特に行きたい学校や勉強したいことがあるわけではないです
dialogue.English: It's not like there's a particular school I want to go to or something I want to study.

dialogue.content: なので勉強もやる気が出ません
dialogue.English: So I'm not motivated to study either.

dialogue.content: もう少し学生生活を楽しむ事ができたら道も開けてくるのではないかと思いますが
dialogue.English: I think if you could enjoy your student life a little more, new paths might open up for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あまなつさんは勉強するのがあまり好きではないですか？
dialogue.English: Amanatsu, do you not like studying very much?

dialogue.content: 自分の気分が乗っている時はファミレスとかで長時間勉強したりします
dialogue.English: When I'm in the mood, I'll study for a long time at a family restaurant or something.

dialogue.content: 学校ではやる気でないですね
dialogue.English: I just don't feel motivated at school.

dialogue.content: うんうん　そういう時ってありますよね
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm, that happens sometimes, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: 自分一人でやった方がいいんじゃないかと思ったりします
dialogue.English: I sometimes think I'd be better off studying on my own.

dialogue.content: 学校での授業が嫌なのですよね場所が変わったらやる気がでるのかな？
dialogue.English: So it's the classes at school that you dislike. Do you think a change of scenery would help you feel motivated?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Maybe.

dialogue.content: その時の気分によりますが
dialogue.English: It depends on my mood at the time.

dialogue.content: それでもやる気のスイッチが入ったら断然いいですよね
dialogue.English: But still, it's definitely a good thing when you can flip that motivation switch on.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なんか意気込みを感じて来たのですが
dialogue.English: I'm starting to sense some enthusiasm from you.

dialogue.content: そうですか
dialogue.English: You think so?

dialogue.content: 環境が変わったらやる気が出てきそうですね
dialogue.English: It seems like a change in environment could bring out your motivation.

dialogue.content: なんか、一人でやった方ができるんなら 学校行く意味あるのって感じです
dialogue.English: It's like, if I can do it better by myself, what's the point of going to school?

dialogue.content: 一人だったら音楽聴きながらできるし、先生にチクチク言われずにすむし
dialogue.English: If I were alone, I could listen to music while I study, and I wouldn't have to deal with teachers nagging me.

dialogue.content: 朝も自由に起きれるし
dialogue.English: And I could wake up whenever I want in the morning.

dialogue.content: それもそうですね能率の上がる方法で番今日をすることができたら　私もそれは賛成です
dialogue.English: That's true. If you can study in a way that improves your efficiency, I'm all for that.

dialogue.content: 勉強でした
dialogue.English: *I meant studying.

dialogue.content: 今でいう　テレワークですね
dialogue.English: It's like what we call 'remote work' nowadays.

dialogue.content: 結局は出席日数の問題かなと
dialogue.English: In the end, I guess it's an attendance issue.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 現実に考えているのですね
dialogue.English: You're thinking about it realistically.

dialogue.content: 高卒資格のためには耐えるしかないのかな
dialogue.English: I guess I just have to endure it to get a high school diploma.

dialogue.content: ホント意味ないって思うんですけど
dialogue.English: But I really think it's meaningless.

dialogue.content: やはり　入学したからには卒業はしたいですね　　あとはやる気がでてくるかどうか
dialogue.English: Well, since you've enrolled, you do want to graduate. The rest is about whether you can find the motivation.

dialogue.content: (長くなってすみません、時間過ぎましたね)
dialogue.English: (Sorry for taking so long, our time is up, isn't it?)

dialogue.content: まぁ 卒業しないとまずいかなと
dialogue.English: Well, I guess not graduating would be a problem.

dialogue.content: はい　解決まで至りませんでしたが高校を卒業する意味があることも理解しておいてくださいね
dialogue.English: Yes. We haven't reached a full resolution, but please try to understand that there is meaning in graduating from high school.

dialogue.content: どうしたらやる気って出るんでしょうねテンション高い子の気持ちがわかりません
dialogue.English: I wonder how people get motivated. I don't understand how those high-energy kids feel.

dialogue.content: はい もう少し考えてみます
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll think about it a bit more.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 多分　毎日を楽しく過ごす方法を見つけ出していけたら　朝目が覚めて嬉しくなると思います
dialogue.English: Probably, if you can find ways to enjoy each day, you'll wake up in the morning feeling happy.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: では終了します
dialogue.English: I will end the session now.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.
